webhooks.description: Send events, such as approved translations, to other services as HTTP requests.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add one to let your CI, chat or other services know when translations are approved, entries are added or tasks end.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_TRANSLA: In the editor or by an approving import, with the approved texts.
New or changed in the editor, by machine translation, or by an import that doesn't approve.
With the texts and the reviewer's comment.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_ENTRIES: In the app or by an import.
webhooks.eventHelp.WEBHOOK_EVENT_TASK_RU: With what the run did, e.g. the pull request of a git export.
